Package com.splendor.config

Class FileConfigProvider

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.config.FileConfigProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
IConfigProvider
public class FileConfigProvider extends Object implements IConfigProvider
Production implementation of IConfigProvider that loads configuration from a properties file located in the classpath resources.
